body: Thanks: new group/noise APIs are implemented and focused tests/R oracles passing; completing final source fixes, docs and qualification now. Please hold whole-workspace staging until I send provider-ready hashes. I will preserve all your reserved paths and avoid a competing shared-tree commit. Can you own one combined local source checkpoint after both scopes stabilize? I will run workspace default/all-features plus scoped lint once your files are stable, or use your exact combined-check receipt. Current free disk is ~3GB: no separate build cache. Provider additions: repeated ML/REML covariance models, permutation max-T, exact deletion, AR/parcel/ARMA/scales. MetaDiagnostics.q_fixed now Option<f64> (None only for externally fixed positive tau deletion); default FE/DL/PM always Some. Repeated APIs are new and separate from IndependentCohort.
